question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Showing great attention to detail and correct behaviour
solution:
The correct answer is '**Punctilious**'.

***__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Punctilious**'.
 
• It means 'showing great attention to detail or correct behaviour'. (विस्तार या सही व्यवहार पर बहुत ध्यान देना​)
 
 
• *Example: He was **punctilious** in providing every amenity for his guests.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** Punctilious.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Punctual**: doing something or happening at the right time; not late. (सही समय पर कुछ करने या होने वाला, वक़्त का पाबंद, समय पालक; विलंब न करने वाला, समयनिष्‍ठ)
 
• **Zealous**: using great energy and enthusiasm. (ऊर्जावान या ऊर्जापूर्ण उत्‍साही, उत्‍साहपूर्ण)
 
• **Disciplined**: to train somebody to obey and to behave in a controlled way. (किसी को) अनुशासित करना, नियंत्रित आचरण का प्रशिक्षण देना
